title: 第十六章 寻找叶欢第十七章 废灵石
lines: 第十六章寻找叶欢
“不知道叶先生是哪里人？”黄德平按捺住心中的兴奋，耐心地问道。
“这些你就不用问了，我知道，即便是我说了，你们也不会信，肯定是要去核查的。”
叶欢站了起来，从背包里掏出一张身份证，道：“这是我的身份证，我的来历，你们自己去调查吧。”
黄德平点点头，也没有推迟，把叶欢的身份证收了起来。
他有心让叶欢做龙腾的教官，身世清白是必须的。
这方面，必须要严谨。
“警卫，带叶先生去休息。”黄德平打开会议室地大门，吩咐道。
等到叶欢被带走后，余军长直接站了起来，脸上写满了不可思议。
“司令，这人……真的是战将级武者？那号称军中战神，带领燕京军区连续5年拿下全军大比冠军的慕洪，可才是战将级啊？”
黄德平笑了笑，反问道：“普通人能够单挑我们五十个特种兵精英吗？那一手火球术你也是亲眼所见。即便是武者，一般的战士级也没有这么强吧，此人应该是战将级无疑了。”
“那司令的意思是想……”他一直在旁边看着，怎么能不知道黄德平的想法。
“对！我就是想让他当龙腾的格斗教官。”
黄德平的表情忽然严肃起来，说道：“不过身份问题不能马虎，你立刻安排人去着手调查，我要在最短的时间内，知道叶欢的全部信息。”
“好，我立刻去安排！”
燕京，胡家。
此刻胡家的气氛格外凝重，那个女小偷被胡家找到了，然后胡家的人却一点也高兴不起来。
因为，紫晶石已经不在女小偷身上了！
在胡家的威逼利诱之下，女小偷绝对是不敢撒谎的。
所以，那块紫晶石的确不在她手里。
据女小偷交代，她偷到木盒子之后，本来想冤枉那个多管闲事的年轻人一顿，没想到那个年轻人眼神格外恐怖，她被吓住了，就赶紧离开了。
然而当她下了火车之后，才发现，那个木头盒子根本不在自己身上。
女小偷怀疑，木头盒子又被那个年轻人偷偷拿回去了。
胡可不明白，那个年轻人明明是见义勇为，怎么会又偷走紫晶石呢？
他如果是真正的小偷，或者其他家族派来抢夺紫晶石的，又何必多此一举，故意抓住女小偷呢？
可是这个女小偷是不会撒谎，胡可相信，这个普通的小偷，还没有能力敢在胡家的威胁下撒谎。
不管如何，都要先找到那个年轻人！
胡家已经找了画师，按胡可的描述把那个年轻人的画像画出来。
可无论如何，胡可用觉得画像和那个男人的形象差了几分。
主要是气质，胡可很难形容，画家也画不出来，只能将就着用。
可是这年轻人却像是泥沉大海一般，无论胡家怎么搜寻，都没有丝毫音讯！

Chapter 16 Looking for Ye Huan
"I wonder where Mr. Ye is from?" Huang Deping suppressed his excitement and asked patiently.
"You don't need to ask these questions. I know that even if I say it, you won't believe it. You must check it."
Ye Huan stood up, took out an ID card from his backpack, and said, "This is my ID card and my origin. You can investigate it yourself."
Huang Deping nodded and put away Ye Huan's ID card without delay.
He intended to let Ye Huan be Long Teng's instructor, and a clean life background was a must.
In this regard, we must be rigorous.
"Guard, take Mr. Ye to rest." Huang Deping opened the door of the conference room and ordered.
After Ye Huan was taken away, Commander Yu stood up directly, with disbelief written on his face.
"Commander, is this man... really a general-level warrior? Is Mu Hong, who is known as the god of war in the military and led the Yanjing Military Region to win the army championship for five consecutive years, a general-level warrior?"
Huang Deping smiled and asked: "Can ordinary people defeat fifty of our special forces elites alone? You have seen that fireball technique with your own eyes. Even if you are a warrior, the average warrior level is not so strong. This person should be a warrior level without a doubt."
"The commander means..." He had been watching from the side, how could he not know what Huang Deping was thinking.
"Yes! I just want him to be Long Teng's fighting instructor."
Huang Deping's expression suddenly became serious and he said: "However, the identity issue cannot be taken lightly. You should immediately arrange for someone to investigate. I want to know all the information about Ye Huan in the shortest possible time."
"Okay, I'll make arrangements right away!"

Yanjing, Hu family.
The atmosphere in the Hu family was extremely solemn at this moment. The female thief was found by the Hu family, but the Hu family was not happy at all.
Because, the amethyst stone is no longer with the female thief!
Under the coercion and inducement of the Hu family, the female thief would never dare to lie.
Therefore, the amethyst stone is indeed not in her hands.
According to the female thief, after she stole the wooden box, she originally wanted to punish the nosy young man, but she didn't expect that the young man's eyes were particularly scary. She was frightened and left quickly.
However, when she got off the train, she realized that the wooden box was not on her at all.
The female thief suspected that the young man had secretly taken the wooden box back.
Hu Ke didn't understand. How could that young man steal the amethyst stone again when he was clearly acting bravely?
If he was a real thief, or someone sent by other families to rob the amethyst stone, why would he bother to deliberately catch the female thief?
But this female thief can't lie. Hu Ke believes that this ordinary thief is not capable of lying under the threat of the Hu family.
No matter what, we must find that young man first!
The Hu family has already found a painter to draw the young man's portrait according to Hu Ke's description.
But no matter what, Hu Keke felt that the portrait was a bit different from the image of the man.
Mainly because of his temperament, Hu Ke is difficult to describe, and the painter can't draw it, so he can only make do with it.
But this young man seemed to be lost in the sea. No matter how hard the Hu family searched, there was no news!
